title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM 2
text:
BUSINESS STUDIES FORM TWO MARKING SCHEME
 1. Outline four functions of retailers to consumers (4marks)
 Credit facilities
 Provide after sale services
 Provide variety of goods
 Availing goods
 Breaking bulk
 Advice
 2. Outline four circumstances under which one would prefer to be paid by cash rather
 than by cheque (4marks)
 If it is the only means of payment available
 Where the amount involved is small
 Where the payee does not accept other means of payment
 Where the payee requires cash urgently
 3. Highlight five factors to be considered when selecting office equipment (5marks)
 Cost
 Adaptability
 Durability
 Effect on staff morale
 Availability of man power
 4. Give four demerits of sole proprietorship as form of business unit (4marks)
 Has unlimited reliability
 Lack of specialization in running of business
 Expansion of the business may be limited by scarcity of capital
 Death of the owner may lead to the collapse of the business
 The owner bears all the risks and in case of a loss he suffers alone
 5. Outline the sources of capital for co-operatives (4marks)
 Members contribution
 Retain profit
 Income from investment
 Income from credit facilities
 6. Outline four circumstances under which a partnership may be dissolved (4marks)
 If the partner mutually agree to dissolve the business
 In case of death , insanity or bankruptcy of a partner
 In case of completion of the intended purpose
 In case of court orders
 7. Highlight the contents of the articles of association (4marks)
 Rights of each type of shareholders
 Methods of calling meetings
 Powers duties and rights of directors
 Rules regarding preparation and auditing of accounts
 8. Give five ways government get involved in business activates (5marks)
 Producing goods and services
 Distributing goods and services
 Advising producers and traders
 As a consumer of goods and services
 Promoting trade and economic development
 9. State three ways in which government may regulate business activities (3marks)
 Licensing
 Ensuring standards
 Legistlation
 10. List five methods used by the government to protect consumers (5marks)
 Setting up standards
 Weights and measures acts
 Foods and drugs act
 Licenses
 Public health act
 11. Highlight limitation of consumers-initiated method of consumer protection (5marks)
 Lack of support from the government
 Lack of enough capital to finance their organisations
 Ignorance of consumers about their rights
 Reluctance of many consumers to join this associations
 Lack of initiative from consumers to check on traders performance
 12. Give four essential element of transport (4marks)
 Unit of carriage
 Methods of propulsion
 Ways
 Terminals
 13. Highlight five importance of transport to business (5marks)
 Linking consumers to producers
 Employment creation
 Promote specialization
 Making goods and services more useful
 Avoiding wastage
 14. Give two trends in transport (2mks)
 Pipeline and containerization
 Electric trains and replacing diesel engines
